title: Implementation coverage matrix
description: Merged PRs referencing each HIP, per component — every spec in the inventory: specs hottest first (most referencing activity), untouched specs at the bottom. The governance column is each spec's lifecycle status — often the explanation for a blank row (a deferred or review-stage spec has no implementation yet by design). A dash means no PR reference was found: a lead to check, not proof the work is missing (older specs and the younger SDKs are especially prone to missing references). Click a filled cell to list its PRs — every count is independently checkable. The long-format source ships as hip_repo_activity.csv alongside the wide download here.
